run_TransformerLensTransparentLlm: run a TransformerLensTransparentLlm model on a list of text prompts and inspect internal activations
test_model_info: test the TransformerLensTransparentLlm model_info method to verify name, layers, heads, and vocabulary size
test_residual_in_and_out: test that residual_in of each layer matches the residual_out of the previous layer
test_residual_plus_block: test that residual output equals residual input plus attention and FFN block outputs
test_tensor_shapes: test that all internal tensors like logits, neuron activations, and attention matrices have correct shapes
